errors.text_span: Графиката не разполага с традиционно изчертана оста Y с вертика
errors.evidence: The sentence is incomplete, cutting off mid-word. It seems the word was intended to be 'вертикална ос'.

The description completely omits any mention of the two data series shown on the chart. It fails to describe the blue dashed line representing 'Брой' (Count) and the orange solid line representing 'Стойност, млн. лв.' (Value, million BGN). No data points, trends, peaks (e.g., the 5667.2 peak in 2019), or other values are mentioned, which is the primary information conveyed by the chart and a core requirement of the prompt.

While the description notes the absence of a drawn Y-axis, it completely fails to mention the two different units for the data, which are specified in the legend ('Брой' for count and 'Стойност, млн. лв.' for value in millions of BGN). This is essential information that functions in place of a standard Y-axis label.
